reviews.review:
I bought this when it came out because I am a totaly fanboy for the Warhammer Universe. This was, fortunately, the game that made me stop buying these on release out of principle.

The game is just a button masher focused on cool visual effects requiring a minimum of actual input from the player. The level design is repetitive and boring, and the gameplay is also extremely stagnant. The worst aspect, however, is the hilariously bogus plot in which you have no choice but to get duped (in a very obvious fashion), activate a clearly oriented Chaos Gate (which was very obvious) and then fight off the hordes that you had no idea would come pouring forth. Oh and then to make it gritty, there's a lame subplot about your guy being accused of heresy. That doesn't really lead anywhere.

I only played 5 hours because I beat the campaign and never wanted to touch it again. Oh and the full campaign only took 5 hours.

If there is one thing Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine succeeds at, it's making you feel like a powerfull ultramarine!
The whole weaponry, melee weapons and jetpack combo really help empowering the player and feeling like a war machine.
The world is beautifull, the scenery and enviroment really impressive and grandiose.

It is a shame that such effort and details were not put into the characters and story.
The people you encounter are all bland, with monotone voices and no expressions.
The story is also very predicable, I mean laughably predictable.

Hopefully, some really epic moments here and there help making the game interesting.
What is hard forgive, is a last boss, that simply is quick time action.
let that sink in for a moment!

I do recommend this game for anyone who like a very simple hack and slash type game and are fan of the warhammer 40k world.

If you do not intend to play but wish to see only the best, funniest and important story moment of the whole game, all edited with added special effect and commentaries, make sur to take a look at this video I made.
Warning: SPOILERS!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UQCxeG9K7jI&t=25s
Very entertaining game! Extremely fun and awesome history

Game breaking bug that makes me crash at a certain part of the game keeping me from finishing the game. From what I played its pretty mediocre and cookie cutter, but still a decent game. If you like 40k and SPACE MURINES and don't crash it might be decent, but as things stand right now I can't finish the game.
